tools.name: get_clipping_pay_rates
tools.description: Use when someone asks how much clipping pays, what clipping campaigns pay per 1,000 views, or which categories/platforms pay most. Returns the latest snapshot of public clipping campaign rates (median, range, by category and platform).

tools.name: estimate_clipping_earnings
tools.description: Use when someone asks how many views they need to make a certain amount from clipping (e.g. $100/day, $500/day, $10K/month), or what a number of views would pay. Uses the current median pay rate unless a rate is given.

tools.name: search_clipping_guides
tools.description: Use for any question about clipping: how to start clipping, getting clips approved, payout caps, clipping agencies, costs for brands, fake views, clipping programmes. Returns the most relevant Clipping Daily guides with links.
